title: fix(grid): a grouped row moves to its new group once its row is left, and group subtotals and the footer total follow a cell save (#35689 slice B)
body:
Fixes #35689 — slice B (groups and totals after a save). Slice A (touch, accessibility, checked rows) landed earlier on its own PR, so nothing else on the card is left.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表页按阶段分组时，把一条的阶段从甲改成乙：停在这一行时它不动，点到别的行后它出现在乙组，两组的条数和金额小计都对；改金额后分组小计和表尾合计马上更新。
- 列表行内编辑重做专题的最后一块（分组与合计随保存更新），这张卡至此做完。
- 出错时最坏是分组小计或表尾合计显示旧数字、或这一行要刷新后才换组，保存的数据本身不受影响；可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

Measured first on `origin/main` 285ad8d7, in a list that selects a cell first (the list page's grid), with the card-named pins below run against the unchanged source:

| Card item | Server grouping | Browser grouping | Premise |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| A row whose stage changed moves to its new group after the user leaves the row | did not move | did not move | holds: broken |
| Group counts and amount subtotals after the save | not refreshed | not refreshed | holds: broken |
| Footer total, flat grid whose rows are the whole set | not refreshed | n/a | holds: broken |
| Footer total, grid paged on the server (whole-set figure) | already re-read after a write | n/a | false: works on main, pinned only |

Why: a select-first save redraws only its own row (the row patches of #35685) and the list lets its own write go by on the bus, so nothing is read again. The groups, the group headers' numbers and the footer's row figures read the rows as loaded, not as saved. The whole-set footer listens to the bus itself, so it already re-asked.

What this PR does, all in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`:

- **The figures read the saved rows.** `rowsAsSaved` (in `objectGridRowPatch.ts`) gives the rows with each saved row in place of the one read, while that read is the one held. The footer reads it, so a flat grid's total includes the saved value at once. A grid that groups the rows it was handed buckets it, so its counts and subtotals follow the save.
- **A row whose save changed a grouping field is held in its group until the row is left.** `writeRowInPlace` notes such a record in `heldInGroup`. The browser bucketing reads that record as it was loaded (it stays in its group, counted and summed there). `onCellSelect` on a cell of another row lets it go: the browser bucketing then moves it, and a server-grouped grid reads its group headers and open groups' rows again (`regroupNonce`). A cell of the same row does not let it go. Any later save on a held row waits with it.
- **Any other save in a server-grouped grid re-asks only the headers** (`savedFigureNonce`), so subtotals update at once and no row is read again. `objectGridGrouping.ts` now keys the header query on that nonce and the row pages on `regroupNonce` alone.
- A grid without the select-first model still reads everything again after each save, as before (control pin).

Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` gains one bullet under the per-cell save section. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## Tests

One new top-level describe in the component's existing select-first save harness, `ObjectGrid.autosave-35685.test.tsx`: "ObjectGrid — groups, subtotals and the footer total after a cell save (objectstack#35689)". It covers both grouping paths: the server, where the grid asks its own group headers and group pages, and the browser, where it buckets rows a host hands it.

- Card line 「离开这一行后它出现在乙组，两个组的条数和金额小计正确」, on each path: a stage pasted from Prospect to Won keeps the row in Prospect, with both groups at their old figures. A click on another cell of the same row keeps it there too. A click on a cell of another row moves it to Won, and the groups read Prospect 1 · 100 and Won 2 · 80.
- Card text 「分组小计…随保存更新」, on each path: an amount saved is in its group's subtotal at once. No row is read again. A server-grouped grid asks its headers exactly once more, and a browser-grouped one asks nothing.
- Card line 「表尾合计在改了金额后更新」: in a flat grid whose rows are the set, the footer sum goes from 180 to 200. In a grid paged on the server, the whole-set footer is read again and reads 200 (this holds on main and is pinned only).
- Control: without `cellSelection`, a write on the bus re-reads the grouped grid at once.

Ablations: one run per leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Every anchor hit x1 and went to x0, and every restore came back to the HEAD blob `f5aebf14` with `git diff HEAD` empty. The suites import the grid by relative path (source), so no dist leg was owed:

| A1 | `onCellSelect` no longer lets a held row go | 2: the move pin on both paths |
| A2 | no header re-ask on a save | 1: server subtotal |
| A3 | the grouping reads the loaded rows | 2: browser move and browser subtotal |
| A4 | the footer reads the loaded rows | 1: flat footer |
| A5 | a held row is bucketed as saved | 1: browser hold before leaving |

## Acceptance notes

- "Leaving the row" means selecting a cell of another row (a click, the arrow keys, Tab across the row's end). Escape, or a click outside the grid, keeps the row selected, so it stays in its group until another row is selected or the list loads again.
- When a server-grouped grid regroups on leaving a row, it reads the open groups' rows again, so a group pager turned past page 1 starts over at page 1, as on any refresh.
- A held record stays noted after a later full load. The next time a row is left, the groups are read one extra time. That read is harmless.
